reason: I already ask Claude about my portfolio, but then I make the trades myself, and that's on purpose. A cute pet that invests and pays for me with real money is exactly the part I don't want to hand over, and with no broker named and no price set there's nothing here for me to sign up for yet.
objection: I don't trust an AI to act with my money, even within limits. A kill switch and a downloadable record only help after something has already gone wrong, and I'd still be the one stuck explaining a bad trade to myself.
would_change_my_mind: A named, licensed broker holding the money with SIPC coverage, plus a few months of watching it run on demo money where it only suggests and I approve every trade.
